description: Search Election.org's 2026 FEC candidate filings by public name or FEC ID, state, office, or district. Returns party, filing status, available campaign totals, source dates and record links. FEC records stay in data.records. A separately sourced data.state_authority_records list currently adds Mississippi federal qualifying entries, including candidates with no matched FEC ID. Check both collections; neither proves final ballot certification or complete nationwide/local coverage. Do not request federal finance for a null FEC ID. Federal filings are ordered by reported receipts, not an endorsement. No party is excluded.

state.description: Two-letter state or territory code of the public records being researched, not the user's location.

name: search_candidates
title: Find federal candidate records
